J_final_conclusions.headline: Across the full S&P 500 Phase 3 corpus, contemporaneous MD&A tone vs NI YoY associations are mostly weak-to-modest; FDR-surviving companies are a small minority of ranking-eligible names.

K_website_recommendations.primary_metric: 10-Q NI should be the primary company metric (form-homogeneous, largest n).
K_website_recommendations.display_first: Show Spearman alongside Pearson; lead with Spearman for robustness, keep Pearson for familiarity + CI.
K_website_recommendations.ranking_n: Prefer n>=8 for public rankings; keep n>=6 as exploratory/limited-sample tier.
K_website_recommendations.show_p_values: Show p-values only with sample size and CI; never alone. Prefer FDR q for multi-company claims.
K_website_recommendations.fdr_badge: Yes — badge FDR-surviving 10-Q NI results (q<0.05), with explicit multiple-comparison disclaimer.
K_website_recommendations.hide_10k: Keep 10-K visible but secondary/collapsed until more annual history accumulates; do not pool as primary.
K_website_recommendations.revenue_secondary: Yes — revenue secondary; exclude/label Financials & Real Estate as non-comparable.
disclaimers: Contemporaneous same-filing association only — not prediction, forecasting, alpha, or trading advice.
Tone and accounting YoY can disagree for legitimate accounting reasons (one-time items, base effects).
Small n and extreme YoY can inflate Pearson; inspect Spearman, agreement, and outliers.
FDR controls false discoveries across many companies; most names will not survive.
Production rankings must not imply causal management-tone effects on earnings.

L_supabase_footprint.note: Estimate for legacy production sync keys with compact points (no sentence blobs, no stats_phase2).

M_limitations: Associations are contemporaneous within the same filing; they are not predictive.
NI YoY base effects (near-zero priors, loss↔profit flips) can dominate Pearson.
10-K samples remain short for many registrants; combined pooling mixes form dynamics.
FDR is applied across ranking-eligible companies; it does not make individual r causal.
Financials/Real Estate revenue is intentionally non-comparable and excluded from revenue rankings.
MD&A extraction quality varies; residual extraction failures bias coverage by sector/ticker.
Sentiment is FinBERT sentence-average tone, not a human reading of emphasis or risk language.
Multiple thresholds (n=6/8/10/12) change who appears 'strong' — treat rankings as sensitivity analysis.
